reason: The cited evidence confirms superconductivity in a similar bcc HEA (E1) and isotropic s-wave pairing in related films (E3), but none of the passages provide direct support for the claimed link between local lattice distortions and a uniform high density of states, nor for the predicted effect of heat treatment on Tc.
premises: Local lattice distortions in bcc HEA create a uniform high density of states at the Fermi level
These distortions support robust, isotropic s-wave electron-phonon coupling
Superconductivity emerges at low temperatures despite significant chemical disorder
Reducing local disorder via heat treatment will lower Tc or increase magnetic sensitivity
